//README: Deliberate non-coverage of a BEHAVIORAL name — one a user can reach that no suite asserts. Each key is a global name; each value is the reason it needs no direct suite. Internal helpers are NOT listed here: the gate never fails on them, so waiving them would be noise. A behavioral name belongs here only when a direct suite would add no protection a feature-level suite or the golden compare does not already give — say so, specifically. Regenerate tests/coverage-inventory.md after editing (node tools/build-coverage-inventory.js). Keys starting with // are notes, not waivers (a real global can start with _, so _ is not a safe note marker).
//status: 3.10.5 wires the gate on. The 28 gaps are closed: updateCpuRanges/updateMemoryRanges gained a real suite (range-linking-test.js); the remaining 26 are waived below. Every one is DOM-state, keyboard, cross-window, or download/anchor plumbing whose computed core (where it has one) is already pinned by a named suite or the golden compare. What they add on top — a class toggle, an aria attribute, an anchor click, a window handoff — is browser behavior a node/vm sandbox cannot honestly exercise; it belongs to the Playwright E2E suite scheduled next in 3.10, which also retires the outstanding 3.9 browser smoke-test debt. Each reason names what is left unasserted and why.
toggleCloudProvider: Checkbox → selectedProviders push/filter, then refreshes the exclude controls. Pure DOM-state wiring with no computed output to assert; the provider checkboxes are driven end-to-end by the Playwright E2E suite (3.10.x).
toggleExcludeTypes: Show/hide of #excludeControls off a checkbox, delegating the render to updateExcludeControls. Visibility-only wiring; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
handleRecommendationTypeChange: Show/hide of #optimizationControls off the recommendation-type radio. Visibility-only wiring; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
toggleCurrentGenerationFilter: Reads the current-generation checkbox and logs it; the filter value is consumed by the generate path, which the golden compare pins. No standalone output to assert; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
toggleMainFamiliesFilter: Show/hide of the main-families restriction controls off a checkbox. Visibility-only wiring; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
toggleProcessorManufacturerFilter: Show/hide of the processor-manufacturer restriction controls off a checkbox. Visibility-only wiring; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
toggleCsvMenu: Open/close of the CSV download dropdown — sets aria-expanded and arms/disarms an outside-click listener. DOM/interaction wiring with no computed output; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
_csvMenuOutsideClick: Outside-click handler that closes the CSV dropdown and resets aria-expanded. Pure interaction wiring, paired with toggleCsvMenu; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
togglePastePanel: Show/hide of the paste panel plus focus of the textarea. Visibility/focus wiring; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
onRuleChange: One-line delegator to checkRuleConflicts, which flags rule conflicts by restyling rule groups and toggling conflict-message elements. DOM-messaging wiring with no computed output a node/vm sandbox can assert; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
openAppPortfolio: Serializes the portfolio payload into a size-guarded localStorage copy and opens the App Portfolio window (postMessage is the primary handoff). Cross-window behavior that needs a real window; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
manualCancelEdit: Clears window._manualEditIndex and re-renders the manual-entry form. One-line cancel + DOM-render wiring; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
disarmPresetButton: Timer/DOM disarm of a two-click preset button — restores the label, drops the armed class, clears the arming hint only if unchanged. Interaction/timer wiring with no computed output; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
onPresetNameKeydown: Enter/Escape keyboard wiring for the preset-name field, delegating to confirmSavePreset (covered by presets-test.js) / cancelSavePreset. Keyboard wiring only; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
importPresets: Opens the hidden preset-import file input (input.click()). Trivial file-picker trigger; the import parse/apply is covered by presets-test.js via applyPresetImportText. E2E-verified (3.10.x).
handlePresetImportFile: FileReader wrapper that hands the file text to applyPresetImportText (covered by presets-test.js) and resets the input so the same file re-fires. FileReader/DOM wiring only; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
compareScenarios: Guard (>= 2 pinned runs) then renderScenarioComparison. The comparison CSV builders are covered by scenario-compare-test.js; this adds only the guard + DOM render. E2E-verified (3.10.x).
downloadScenarioComparison: Guard then buildScenarioComparisonCsv / buildScenarioComparisonCsvN (both covered by scenario-compare-test.js) piped to an anchor download. The CSV body is pinned by that suite; this adds only the anchor-download plumbing. E2E-verified (3.10.x).
switchPortfolioTab: Tab active-class + aria-selected + panel show/hide across .pf-tab/.pf-panel. Visibility/aria wiring; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
sortPortfolioApps: Flips overviewState sort key/direction and re-renders the app table. Sort-state wiring with no computed output beyond the render; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
togglePortfolioFilter: Sets a boolean overviewState filter (noMatchOnly / complianceOnly) and re-renders the app table. Filter-state wiring; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
onPortfolioMessage: Cross-window message router — enforces origin === location.origin and source === window.opener, then hands the payload to receivePortfolio (covered by portfolio-test.js). The routing/guard needs a real opener + postMessage; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
exportPortfolioWorkbook: Async XLSX export — ensurePortfolioXlsx, build the workbook, anchor-download, with button busy-state. Async spreadsheet-engine + download plumbing; the portfolio model it serializes is covered by portfolio-test.js. E2E-verified (3.10.x).
downloadAppCsv: Builds a per-app VM CSV from the portfolio model (columns via vmDetailColumns, covered by portfolio-test.js) and triggers an anchor download. Adds only the download plumbing; E2E-verified (3.10.x).
downloadResultsXlsx: Async XLSX export of the results table — ensure engine, build, anchor-download, with button busy-state. Async spreadsheet-engine + download plumbing; the row content is pinned by the golden CSV compare. E2E-verified (3.10.x).
handleFileUpload: input[type=file] change wrapper that hands the File to ingestFile. ingestFile is covered by upload-guards-test.js, xlsx-ingest-test.js and sheet-picker-test.js; this is the one-line event wiring. E2E-verified (3.10.x).
